label: Squarespace Commerce
terms_note: Requires the Commerce Advanced plan to create Developer API Keys (per-API read / read-write permissions; keys never expire while the site is active); third-party commercial apps must use OAuth as a Squarespace Extension; rate limit not on the pages read (FAQ 404); credentials only reach the owning site's data.

discovery.auth: api_key (Developer API Key from Settings › Advanced on Commerce Advanced sites, non-expiring; OAuth for Squarespace Extensions / third-party apps)

rate_limits: 300 requests/min (5 rps); Create Order 100/h per site with API key

auth: 1. Tenant on Commerce Advanced opens Settings › Advanced › Developer API Keys and creates a key with Products, Inventory and Orders read-write.
2. Paste the key; the platform sends it as a bearer token.
3. (Extensions path: OAuth app at account.squarespace.com/developer-apps — needed only for webhooks / multi-site distribution.)

endpoints.purpose: physical / service products with variants (pricing per variant), images

reference.limits: Not on the pages read (FAQ page 404); handle 429 with back-off. - Commerce Advanced plan required for API keys. - Third-party commercial integrations must be OAuth Extensions.
mcp_sdk: none official found in the pages opened

fields.name: api_key
fields.help: Developer API key (Commerce Advanced plan: Settings > Advanced > Developer API Keys; Orders read, Products read) sent as `Authorization: Bearer`; the docs also require a descriptive User-Agent, which the runtime sends.

me.note: GET /v2/commerce/products (Products read) lists up to 50 products {products[{id, name, type, storePageId, isVisible, url, ...}], pagination}; verifies the key and shows the store's products.

end_listing.note: POST /v2/commerce/products/{productId} {isVisible: {present: true, value: false}} (the Update product endpoint's ChangeBoolean wrapper) hides the product; reversible with value=true. Returns the updated ProductV2. DELETE /v2/commerce/products/{productId} (204, irreversible) is not used.

list_orders.note: GET /1.0/commerce/orders?fulfillmentStatus(PENDING|FULFILLED|CANCELED) returns up to 50 orders by modification date {result[{id, orderNumber, createdOn, fulfillmentStatus, grandTotal{value, currency}, fulfillments[{trackingNumber, carrierName}]}], pagination{hasNextPage, nextPageCursor}}. Pagination is cursor-based, so `page`/`limit` are not sent (first page only); `since` is not sent because modifiedAfter is only accepted together with modifiedBefore.

not_offered.create_listing: POST /v2/commerce/products requires `storePageId` and a `variants[{sku, pricing{basePrice{value, currency}}, stock{quantity}}]` array of objects — the price lives inside the array, which the flat/dotted body cannot express.
not_offered.update_listing: POST /v2/commerce/products/{productId} takes every field as a {present: true, value} change object (ChangeString / ChangeUpdateProductPricing); `present` would have to be sent only for the arguments actually given, but the body form sends literals unconditionally, so a partial update (e.g. description only) would also send name/pricing wrappers without a value, whose effect is undocumented.
not_offered.set_inventory: POST /1.0/commerce/inventory/adjustments takes setFiniteOperations[{variantId, quantity}] (an array of objects, not expressible) and answers 204 No Content.
not_offered.mark_shipped: POST /1.0/commerce/orders/{id}/fulfillments takes shouldSendNotification (boolean) and shipments[{carrierName, trackingNumber, trackingUrl, shipDate}] (an array of objects) and answers 204 No Content — not expressible in the flat/dotted body.
not_offered.listing_metrics: The Commerce APIs expose Transactions (financial records) but no per-product views or conversion metrics.

evidence: host api.squarespace.com: DNS ok, TLSv1.3 (DigiCert Inc)
probe: 3/3 tools answered on their documented path with an auth refusal, a validation error or data; control route answered 401 too, so the host authenticates before routing
HTML docs spot-check (render-doc): 2/3 tool paths found verbatim on their docs pages; every parameter and body key named on the page
